<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?><record_update table="sys_ui_script"><sys_ui_script action="INSERT_OR_UPDATE"><active>true</active><description/><global>false</global><ignore_in_now_experience>false</ignore_in_now_experience><name>x_sded9_portal_t_0.portal_recent_accesse</name><script><![CDATA[(function() {
    'use strict';
    angular.module('portalTracker', []).run(function($rootScope, $location, $window) {
        var STORAGE_KEY = 'recent_accesses';
        var MAX_ITEMS = 6;

        $rootScope.$on('$locationChangeSuccess', function(event, newUrl, oldUrl) {
            // Ignora se não houve mudança real (ex: só hash ou params iguais)
            if (newUrl === oldUrl) return;

            // Ignora páginas específicas, se quiser (ex: home page)
            var currentPath = $location.path();
            if (currentPath === '/' || currentPath === '/sate' || currentPath.includes('?id=sate')) return;  // Ajuste para sua home

            // Pega name (título da página após load) e link
            var name = $window.document.title || 'Página sem título';
            var link = $location.url();  // Formato SPA: '?id=kb_article&sys_id=abc'

            // Carrega itens existentes
            var stored = localStorage.getItem(STORAGE_KEY);
            var data = stored ? JSON.parse(stored) : { user_id: '', items: [] };  // user_id setado no widget (server-side)

            var items = data.items;

            // Remove se já existe (renova posição)
            items = items.filter(function(i) { return i.link !== link; });

            // Adiciona no topo
            items.unshift({ name: name, link: link });

            // Limita a 6
            items = items.slice(0, MAX_ITEMS);

            // Salva de volta
            data.items = items;
            localStorage.setItem(STORAGE_KEY, JSON.stringify(data));
        });
    });
})();]]></script><script_name>portal_recent_accesses_tracker</script_name><sys_class_name>sys_ui_script</sys_class_name><sys_created_by>pk.aba</sys_created_by><sys_created_on>2025-11-04 23:28:25</sys_created_on><sys_id>5613564dfb05f210f6d5f9d38eefdc2f</sys_id><sys_mod_count>1</sys_mod_count><sys_name>x_sded9_portal_t_0.portal_recent_accesse</sys_name><sys_package display_value="Portal Tesouro" source="x_sded9_portal_t_0">724414a2fb192a1086e7f4045eefdcf8</sys_package><sys_policy/><sys_scope display_value="Portal Tesouro">724414a2fb192a1086e7f4045eefdcf8</sys_scope><sys_update_name>sys_ui_script_5613564dfb05f210f6d5f9d38eefdc2f</sys_update_name><sys_updated_by>pk.aba</sys_updated_by><sys_updated_on>2025-11-04 23:42:58</sys_updated_on><ui_type>10</ui_type><use_scoped_format>false</use_scoped_format></sys_ui_script></record_update>
